figurative_meaning_en: Eloquent or skilled in persuasive speech
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে মুখে দড়, যেকোনো বিতর্কে সফল হয়ে যায়।
রাজনীতিতে মুখে দড় লোকেরাই এগিয়ে যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: He is silver-tongued and always wins any debate.
In politics, those with the gift of the gab rise to the top.
note: The idiom metaphorically suggests control or skill in speech, akin to a rope guiding or restraining, but positively for eloquence.
